title: Integration verification: full stack boot
acceptance_criteria: rails db:drop db:create db:migrate completes cleanly — all 37 tables created
rails db:seed loads all CSV seed data without errors
rails server boots without errors or deprecation warnings
HTTP GET / returns 200 with placeholder content
rails console loads, all 37 models accessible and respond to defined methods
Character.new.skill_points returns integer without nil errors
Mecha.new.weight returns a numeric value without nil errors
No SQL injection patterns in any model (no string interpolation in conditions)
No named_scope found anywhere (grep returns empty)
No Devise, Pundit, jQuery present in Gemfile or codebase
deliverables: Working Rails 8 application on phase-1-skeleton branch
